description:
List posts (threads) in a Discord forum channel.

Args:
  - channel_id (string): Forum channel ID to list posts from
  - include_archived (boolean): Also include archived/closed posts (default: false)
  - response_format ('markdown' | 'json'): Output format (default: 'json')

Returns:
  List of forum posts with their tags and status

channel_id.description: Forum channel ID to list posts from

include_archived.description: Whether to also include archived (closed) posts

response_format.description: Output format: 'markdown' for human-readable or 'json' for structured data

name: discord_list_forum_posts
title: List Discord Forum Posts
